research_value.current_state: No production gateway reconstructs an existing intent; execute currently accepts and records a caller-constructed ActionIntent, and ActionIntent has no context_id.
research_value.required_boundary: Accept only task_id, run_id, context_id, and intent_id; resolve the authenticated work-memory lifecycle and one writer; bind context through the existing run lineage; reconstruct exactly one same-journal typed intent; reject mismatches; call only PreventionController.execute.

family_contracts.CREDENTIAL: Resolve typed container, vault, deployment, and credential/config handles from verified preparation; read only safe fingerprints, versions, tags, status and AUTH_OK markers; never secret bytes; require Docker or operator edges when the route crosses those domains.
family_contracts.DOCKER: Resolve prepared image/container/port/source/destination handles; use inspect, logs, read-only exec, health reads, and absence checks; return typed image/container identity, labels, bindings, safe hashes and markers; require credential/Git edges for mixed seed routes.
family_contracts.GIT: Resolve repository and remote keys through trusted registries; use read-only Git object, branch, index, diff, merge-base, remote and trailer queries; return typed local/remote identities and manifest-scoped state.
family_contracts.LOCAL_STATE: Resolve hash-verified preparation, trusted task/runtime/discovery/ledger roots and named files; read canonical artifacts and source-owned receipts or read-only helper status; return route-specific typed facts and hashes.
family_contracts.OPERATOR: Resolve program/task/run/delegation/operator handles; query authenticated Greenfield or MAWF status and remote Git where required; return typed durable program/workflow/run lineage and terminal state.

research_value.implementability: Five authority families are sufficient as a registry, but one edge per owner is not; each route must declare a finite required-edge set and a closed route-specific raw result contract.

research_value.acceptance_boundary: Every supported route traverses the four-ID gateway, real journal/controller/runtime, all required concrete edges, real source, crash reconciliation, and semantic terminal re-observation; unavailable authority returns fail closed.

research_markdown: The production boundary is finite: ten registered operational owners, 43 profiles, and five authority families. The stable gateway accepts only task_id, run_id, context_id, and intent_id and reconstructs the exact same-journal ActionIntent from the authenticated one-writer lifecycle. Preparation already contains normalized parameters, root bindings, and binding receipts; source locators must be reconstructed internally from its content-addressed artifact. The five families are LOCAL_STATE (13), GIT (6), DOCKER (10), CREDENTIAL (8), and OPERATOR (6), but some routes require a finite set of families rather than one owner-selected edge. Each route therefore needs a closed source_query_contract containing trusted locator reconstruction, read-only acquisition, typed raw result schema, terminal semantic predicate, receipt limitation, and explicit unavailable-authority state. Receipts prove effect ownership, while fresh domain reads prove semantic truth. Current acceptance captures cannot be promoted to production evidence. Missing provider implementations are future implementation work; their names, required inputs, fail-closed states, and verification boundary are finite and handed to planning.
